mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing demand, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit expectations decline.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above its 12-month MA for 6 consecutive months, yet S&P 500 still produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market slack that reduces corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 6.5% for 6 months, yet S&P 500 still produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 5.5% for 6 months, yet S&P 500 still produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month rise in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals residential construction expansion that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: HOUST remains below its 12-month MA for 6 months, yet S&P 500 still produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
